Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #228 in Moneo. At the end of each assistant chat message, show a small row of actions: **Copy** (copies the message text), **Regenerate** (reruns the last assistant reply) and the **model** that produced the reply (a small label, or a tooltip on an icon). Find the chat message component and where the model id is known at response time (lib/ai/provider.ts, the /api/chat route). If the message doesn't store the model yet, store it (a new migration in supabase/migrations/ plus lib/schema.ts if a column is needed), so it also shows for old chats after reload. Keep it compact, accessible (aria-labels), working on mobile and in light/dark.

## RESUME: earlier work exists
An earlier agent on this issue was stopped partway through and left uncommitted work in the worktree at `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-74646337-66fc2da42e266501`, on branch `t3/issue-228-chat-message-actions`. Don't start from scratch:
1. Inspect it read-only: `git -C <that path> status`, `git -C <that path> diff`, and its untracked files.
2. Bring that work into your own checkout: `git -C <path> diff HEAD > <your scratch>/old.patch`, then `git apply` it, and copy the untracked files.
3. Review what's done, then finish it. Never modify, reset or delete the old worktree.
4. Use your own branch name `t3/issue-228-message-actions` (the old branch name is taken by that worktree).

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 228 --comments`.
- Commit each step in plain language, ending each message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- The moneo-qa backend and QA port 3100 are shared with other agents: never `npm run qa:reset`, never `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`, never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`). If 3100 is busy with another checkout, wait and retry; never kill a process you didn't start. If `npm ci` stalls, retry it once with `--prefer-offline` before borrowing node_modules.
- Before finishing: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`; verify-ui skill (light/dark/mobile) with the evidence in the PR.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #228`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

content.text:
Issue #228 is implemented and the PR is open against `main`. It is not merged.

- **What it does:** each assistant reply now ends with Copy, Regenerate and the model label. The model comes from the existing `chat_requests.usage` data, so no migration was needed, and old chats show it after reload.
- **Earlier work:** I applied the stopped agent's patch and finished it, leaving its worktree untouched.
- **Checks:** lint, typecheck and build pass. `npm test` has one failure: `lib/cron.test.ts` times out at the 5s default on this machine. It passes alone with a 120s timeout (4.9s), so I left it alone; it's noted in the PR.
- **Screenshots:** the seeded reply renders the actions row correctly in light, dark and mobile. Full-page and row-crop PNGs are in `.qa/shots/228/`. They are git-ignored, so you'll need to drag them into the PR on GitHub. Regenerate and Copy clicks weren't exercised because the QA AI key is a placeholder that rejects every call.
- **Pre-existing mobile issue:** the "Moneo can use…" footer overlaps the bottom-left avatar. Not from this change.
- **CI:** GitGuardian passed; `checks` and `database` are still running.
